name: Flexiroam Limited
summary: Flexiroam Limited, a mobile data operator, provides voice and data roaming services to travellers in Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, South America, Oceania, and Antarctica. Its products include Flexiroam X, an app that enables data connectivity; FLEXI+ that offers data backing services to enterprises; and XACE, which provides programmable data connectivity to Internet of Things and SuperApps players to enable its hardware/software to stay connected with multiple networks. Flexiroam Limited has partnership with Mastercard Incorporated. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Petaling Jaya, Malaysia.
